nodes.name: Saturating lane
nodes.behavior: One scalar elastic output-slot lane. data_i packs signed 4-bit a in high nibble and b in low nibble. Compute a+b with enough intermediate width; clamp to[-8,7]; encode result in unsigned4-bit two's-complement data_o. Reset data_o=0,valid_o=0. can_accept=(!old_valid_o)||ready_i; if can_accept then valid_o=valid_i and update data_o only for valid input; else hold. ready_o=(!new_valid_o)||ready_i after edge.  Sample active-low rst_array_n synchronously only on rising clk_array edges; no asynchronous reset response.
nodes.test_expectations: Preserve all independent16-cycle scalar expectations, including signed positive and negative saturation, stalls, idle data retention and reset flush. Four instances must later be checked with the independent24-cycle system contract.

global_integration.behavior: Four independent instances of one scalar elastic output-slot definition. data_i packs signed 4-bit a in high nibble and b in low nibble. Compute a+b with enough intermediate width; clamp to[-8,7]; encode result in unsigned4-bit two's-complement data_o. Reset data_o=0,valid_o=0. can_accept=(!old_valid_o)||ready_i; if can_accept then valid_o=valid_i and update data_o only for valid input; else hold. ready_o=(!new_valid_o)||ready_i after edge. No cross-lane state, routing, result reuse or shared validity. Global source expectation is4 compiled instances, not4 independent RTL definitions. Instantiate exactly the four members of the one adopted scalar definition using their saved canonical instance names. Bind each laneXX input/output stream to its explicit member coordinate. Keep the four states independent and share only clk_array and synchronous active-low rst_array_n. Top integration adds wires only, with no repeated arithmetic or additional state.
